The infrastructure exists. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.

content.text: The Full List With Context

Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each payment option on this list matters because it offers a distinct solution to the problem of accessing global markets. For instance, NOWPayments stands out for its 0.5% fee and support for over 300 cryptocurrencies. CoinPayments, on the other hand, offers a wide range of integrations with popular e-commerce platforms. By considering these differences, creators can choose the payment option that best aligns with their business goals and target audience.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many digital creators in Ethiopia and Ghana mistakenly believe that they must rely on traditional payment platforms or workarounds. However, these approaches often come with significant fees, cumbersome processes, and limited scalability. In contrast, blockchain-based payment options offer a more direct, secure, and cost-effective way to receive payments from customers worldwide. By avoiding common pitfalls and embracing sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can unlock new revenue streams and expand their global reach.

How to Prioritise What to Implement First

To prioritise payment options, Ethiopian digital creators should consider factors such as transaction fees, ease of integration, and customer support. They should also evaluate the level of sovereignty and control offered by each payment gateway. By prioritising options that offer low fees, seamless integrations, and robust customer support, creators can establish a reliable payment system that meets their unique needs and goals.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

By combining blockchain-based payment options with sovereign commerce infrastructure, digital creators in Ethiopia and Ghana can establish a deployable stack that enables them to sell their digital products globally. This stack can include components such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. With the right stack in place, creators can efficiently manage payments, deliver products, and scale their businesses without relying on traditional payment platforms.
